scope: blind semantic audit infrastructure only; no case materialization, future reveal, action value, PnL or MBO

completed_candle_interpretation.rule: a no-trade minute causally synthesized by the registered exchange clock is a completed market-time candle and participates in the frozen structure protocol
completed_candle_interpretation.unknown_gap: an unregistered or over-limit missing interval is not synthesized and causes the existing hard history reset
completed_candle_interpretation.reason: this freezes the already-implemented behavior before sample counts are observed and does not change the parent primitive or structure code hash

passes: pass1 scans only reader and observer semantic state and atomically freezes the selection authority manifest
pass2 replays each frozen case from the same source prefix and requires the same event id, case clock and semantic state hash before rendering
selection.score: SHA-256 of score_bytes; retain the two lexicographically smallest scores in each bucket
selection.shortage_policy: unavailable; no cross-year, cross-direction or cross-class backfill
class_precedence: confirmed BOS with scope opposed is broken_or_opposed
pending BOS whose last_attempt_at equals case_clock is wick_only_no_close

artifact_separation.authority_manifest: contains semantic event ids, object ids, class, direction, timeframe and state hashes; reviewer access forbidden
artifact_separation.blind_manifest: contains only opaque case id, case clock, image hash and review-template identity
artifact_separation.blind_image: raw completed four-timeframe candles, axes, timeframe and case-clock boundary only
artifact_separation.truth_overlay: may be produced only after all blind reviews are content-hash locked; it still may not read any post-case future path

review_schema.lock_policy: review and lock files are create-once; every authority, blind, image and review hash is revalidated before evaluation

release_gates.blind_strict_case_agreement: at least 216/240; missing and uncertain count as disagreement
